comparison.objective: Sort acid and base bottles upright into separate containment trays.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object classification, upright transport, and contamination-aware placement.
comparison.success_condition: Every acid is upright in the acid tray, every base upright in the base tray, and incompatible bottles never share a tray.
comparison.reason: Tests chemical segregation and safe bottle placement rather than precision impact and small-fragment containment.
